steps: Lay the tray flat, print side down.
Fold the two side walls up, and fold each wall's corner flaps in.
Fold the front panel up, over the flaps. Roll its rim in and down, and push its two tabs through the floor.
Do the same with the back wall. The flaps are now trapped: no glue.
Fold the seat stair. Slide its rear tabs into the back wall, then push its feet through the floor.
Fold the collar stair the same way, over the seats: rear tabs first, then its feet.
Fold the header double. Press its tongues through the slots in the back wall's rim until they click.
Stand one tester in each front opening, its cap in the opening behind it.
